as_of: 2024-11-18 (before the 2024-12 halt of the restructuring procedures)

facts.relationship: sibling affiliates of the same group (related-party transaction)
facts.plan_2024_07_11: spin off Doosan Bobcat from Doosan Enerbility; comprehensive share exchange making Bobcat a subsidiary of Doosan Robotics; ratio 100 Bobcat : 63 Robotics
facts.fss_review_2024_07_08: FSS required the securities registration statement to be refiled twice, citing insufficient transparency on the exchange-ratio valuation methodology
facts.board_action_2024_08_29: Bobcat and Robotics boards ended the share-exchange agreement 49 days after announcement; the spin-off component was kept
facts.reproposal_2024_10_21: restructuring re-proposed with Bobcat becoming a Robotics subsidiary
facts.revised_ratio: Enerbility holders to receive 88.5 Enerbility shares + 4.3 Robotics shares per 100 held (previously 3.2 Robotics shares)
facts.activist_2024_10_15_to_11_18: Align Partners (~1.0% of Bobcat) letters demanding the re-proposal be dropped, KRW 1.5 trillion buyback budget redirected to a special dividend, and peer-level shareholder return (~65%)
